name: Ambiguous Reference Frames v138
oracle_policy: true frame and labels used only for audit; probe returns noisy frame evidence, not true frame label

policies.act_best_guess: infer most likely frame from ambiguous descriptor and act
policies.always_probe_frame: always acquire extra frame evidence before acting
policies.hold_on_ambiguity: abstain when frame confidence is low
policies.voi_probe_frame: probe only when expected value of frame information is positive

status: synthetic oracle-free frame ambiguity + probe-vs-act test
